name: jaq-wasm
description: Workspace for building and validating the jaq WebAssembly package
author: Mayank Kumar Poddar

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke && cd pkg && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd pkg && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build && cd pkg && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && cd pkg && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:npm:provenance: npm run build && cd pkg && npm publish --provenance --access public
